invalid_query_envelopes.name: unknown-query-name
invalid_query_envelopes.reason: context.render.v9 is not in the v2 query enum

invalid_query_envelopes.name: extra-envelope-field
invalid_query_envelopes.reason: envelope params have additionalProperties=false; callers cannot set actor_id

invalid_query_envelopes.name: missing-selector
invalid_query_envelopes.reason: selector is required by the v2 envelope

invalid_query_envelopes.name: bad-invocation-context-id
invalid_query_envelopes.reason: invocation_context_id must match the v1 id pattern

invalid_query_envelopes.name: payload-not-object
invalid_query_envelopes.reason: the envelope only carries payload as a JSON object; typed checks happen in layer 2

invalid_query_payloads.name: extra-payload-field
invalid_query_payloads.reason: context.render payload is strict: unexpected fields are rejected

invalid_query_payloads.name: missing-include
invalid_query_payloads.reason: include is required (the request must say which sections it wants)

invalid_query_payloads.name: empty-include
invalid_query_payloads.reason: include requires at least one section

invalid_query_payloads.name: unknown-include-section
invalid_query_payloads.reason: include items are limited to the nine v2 section ids

invalid_query_payloads.name: since-commit-seq-not-seq-string
invalid_query_payloads.reason: since.commit_seq uses the v1 seq type (canonical decimal string), not a JSON number

invalid_query_payloads.name: since-render-digest-not-digest
invalid_query_payloads.reason: since.render_digest uses the v1 digest type (64 lowercase hex chars)

invalid_query_payloads.name: attempt-ref-not-object
invalid_query_payloads.reason: attempt_ref uses the v1 object_ref type

invalid_query_payloads.name: mandatory-ref-bad-shape
invalid_query_payloads.reason: mandatory_refs items use the v1 object_ref type

invalid_query_payloads.name: v1-query-missing-required-fields
invalid_query_payloads.reason: v1 queries keep their v1 payload requirements under v2 (no relaxed branch)
